propositions: backtest --check-planning-corpus exits 1 on origin/main with corpus=114 when PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE is pinned to 113, indicating a count mismatch independent of recent changes

the corpus membership is re-derived at runtime from live ticket state (bug-type ticket classification) rather than pinned to a fixed commit set, causing the count to drift when tickets are reclassified or added
pinning by commit SHA identity instead of count makes the corpus immune to tracker churn and live ticket state changes
the module docstring claims the corpus is pinned and reproducible, but the implementation contradicts this by deriving membership dynamically
the fix replaces PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE constant with a PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS frozenset of exact 113 SHAs and measures check-mode rows from the pin rather than re-deriving from live state
